event_summary: A red-orange liquid stream appears from an overhead blue opening, reaches a yellow duck toy, and spreads across a black tray.
raw_event_description: The scene begins with a yellow duck toy standing upright in a black rectangular tray on a tabletop, with a red container and blue opening positioned above it. For several frames, the duck and tray remain unchanged and no red-orange liquid is visible in the tray. A narrow red-orange stream then becomes visible below the blue opening, extending downward to the top of the duck. The liquid coats parts of the duck and collects on the tray floor around it. The red-orange area in the tray grows outward around the duck, extending across much of the tray floor while the duck remains upright in nearly the same position.

reasons: The duck toy, tray, overhead container, blue opening, tabletop, and background stand are visible.
No red-orange stream is visible at the start.
The duck is already positioned under the overhead opening.
